findings.summary: read_rows now returns a one-shot generator but summarize() iterates it twice, so the second loop skips rows consumed by any() (total, by_actor, high omit rows up to the first high event), and can drop a real high-severity alert so render() wrongly prints 'No high-severity audit events today.'
No test covers summarize() with a high-severity row, which is why the generator-reuse bug was not caught.
